contributions.statement: Keep orchestration in deterministic code, make LLM calls narrow with schema-validated outputs, and persist validated intermediate state so only the failed step is retried.
contributions.evidence: §3.2-3.3 Table 2: 51.7%/73.2% retry-cost reduction under one injected failure on two toy tasks with gpt-4; static baseline built to rerun all downstream steps.
relative_to: workflow engines with checkpointed, idempotent steps and schema-validated outputs

contributions.statement: Fine-grained LLM task decomposition can triple token cost in normal (no-failure) operation with no correctness gain, so it pays only when failures and retries are frequent.
contributions.evidence: Tables 1-2: ~3x baseline token cost; all configurations reach 100% correctness on both tasks; 10 runs each, framework-specific overhead (~18%).

reason: RSTD is standard workflow-engine practice renamed, shown on two toy tasks that every configuration solves. The cost nuance is tied to the authors' framework and too weak to carry.
